subject: Interview coverage matrix + bar-raiser ownership for Senior Serving Engineer role
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Interview coverage matrix + bar-raiser ownership for Senior Serving Engineer role

Team —

Attaching a first-pass coverage matrix for the Senior Serving Engineer role we discussed on last week's hiring sync. My goals for this thread:

- Make sure the panel has clear, non-overlapping ownership of domain areas (runtime, systems design, perf debugging, evals).
- Confirm who will take the bar-raiser responsibilities (veto/quality checks + debrief moderator).
- Agree on 6 anchor questions to use in debriefs so grading is consistent across interviewers.

Highlights in the attachment:
- Columns: focus area, timebox, goals for candidate to demonstrate, example follow-ups, slide-in signals for Senior vs Staff.
- Suggested bar-raiser duties listed in the rightmost sheet (moderator, challenge candidate answers, ensure rubric applied).

Proposed: Markus as bar-raiser/moderator for this pipeline — he can call for a do-not-hire or request a follow-up exercise if evidence is weak. Grace and Marissa take runtime & production reliability respectively. Jasmine will own evals/quality signal checks and candidate assignment logistics.

Please review and reply with any carve-outs or objections by EOD today. I want to lock the matrix before the candidate loop next week.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview coverage matrix + bar-raiser ownership for Senior Serving Engineer role

Thanks Logan — quick read-through. A couple of tweaks:

1) Timebox for the runtime deep dive should be 40 minutes (not 30) so we can get into KV cache and memory budgeting tradeoffs.
2) For Senior vs Staff signals, add an explicit expectation around cross-team influence (Senior: owns a subsystem; Staff: sets service-wide patterns).
3) I can take the production reliability slot but would prefer Markus to be the moderator/bar-raiser as proposed.

I also added two anchor questions in-line in the Google doc: one on diagnosing a perf regression that manifests only in tail latency, another on designing a fallback routing policy for degraded capacity.

– Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal, Platform & Hiring Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview coverage matrix + bar-raiser ownership for Senior Serving Engineer role

+1 on Markus as bar-raiser. A couple of operational notes:
- Let's standardize the rubric scores (1-4) and what constitutes 'hire' vs 'maybe' vs 'no hire' at the top of the doc — I added a table in the Notion link.
- For the runtime interview, please prepare a short perf artifact (1-2 slides) that we can give the candidate during the loop to accelerate the exercise — saves time and levels the playing field.

I'll take the lead on the debrief doc after the loop; Markus, if you call a follow-up task we should record that as a conditional hire with scope and success criteria.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview coverage matrix + bar-raiser ownership for Senior Serving Engineer role

Sounds good. A few items I want to call out as bar-raiser guardrails:

1) Evidence bar: For 'hire' decisions I want at least 3 independent signals across system design, debugging, and live production trade-offs. One strong answer alone is not enough.
2) Push on operational maturity: If a candidate can't articulate an incident postmortem with clear owner/action/outcome, that's a warning sign for Senior.
3) Avoid over-indexing on familiarity with our stack vocab — focus on problem-solving and system principles.

I'll prep the anchor questions (6) and drop them into the attachments this afternoon. If anyone feels the list is too leading, please comment in the doc.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Inference Platforms
Redwood Inference
